title: Driftwood Dreams
meta_description: Driftwood Dreams by AvantStay -- a bright 30A retreat with outdoor living, pizza oven \& family spaces.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Driftwood Dreams by AvantStay!

This three-story coastal retreat sits just minutes from the sugar-white sands of Inlet Beach, where turquoise waters and a relaxed atmosphere make every day feel like vacation. Surrounded by the charm of Florida's Scenic 30A, you'll be within easy reach of Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and Seacrest---offering boutique shopping, waterfront dining, and bike paths that wind along the shoreline.

Inside, bright design and open spaces set the tone for connection and comfort. The main living room on the first floor features comfortable seating and a smart TV, flowing into the dining area and full kitchen, complete with a smart fridge and all the essentials for cooking and entertaining. A dedicated kid-friendly reading nook tucked into the first floor invites little ones to settle in with a book while adults gather nearby. A separate first-floor sitting room includes a cozy pull-out sofa for additional sleeping space.

Four bedrooms comfortably sleep up to ten guests: a serene king suite with ensuite bath, two queen rooms, and a twin room perfect for kids or friends. Families will love the thoughtfully designed nursery on the third floor, complete with a pack 'n play and changing table. With three and a half bathrooms, everyone will have space to refresh, including walk-in showers and a shower/tub combo.

Outdoor living is where Driftwood Dreams shines. Sip morning coffee on the covered porch, fire up the BBQ grill or pizza oven for alfresco dinners, or lounge in the sun with a good book. Evenings are best spent around the firepit with chairs for the whole group, while the outdoor shower makes rinsing off after the beach effortless. A washer and dryer add extra convenience for longer stays. Guests also have access to a heated community pool, perfect for relaxing swims in every season---whether you're cooling off after a day at the beach or enjoying a refreshing start to your morning.

Whether it's beach days, sunset bike rides, or starlit nights by the fire, Driftwood Dreams is your perfect escape on Florida's Gulf Coast.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truth:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- A pack'n'play is available upon request.
- The home is equipped with two full sets of washers and dryers for your convenience.
- The communal pool is heated year-round.

Parking Details:
- Parking: 2 driveway spaces are available for guests.
- Street parking is not allowed. Vehicles parked on the street may be towed.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
